Spike scan — telltale action pack

Created = sessions carrying the signal combination; verified = of those, sessions that ended verified — a wide gap means it is being stopped, lines on top of each other mean it is getting through.

Weekend update, Oct 16-18 (data to Oct 19 00:00 UTC)

Still ongoing, not mitigated

  • Adobe ARP FF (Key 8), on the live TT and the grease combo: 959k (Oct 16), 1.42M (Oct 17) and 902k (Oct 18) per day, with 59-75% verified. It peaked at 168k/h on Oct 18 12:00 UTC. The live TT fires but most of it gets through, so the action on this key needs changing. The di-dict3 combo also hit a new high on this key: 251k on Oct 18 (74% verified).
  • Roblox Signup (Key 2) on ends-te + device-param-spoofing: its biggest wave so far, 209k on Oct 18 (19% verified), its 6th burst since Sep 29. It is also on single-click (21k) and di-dict3 (45k).
  • Adobe Commerce (Key 3) on the new ja4-dict1 combo: 35-39k/day since Oct 16, 0% verified, still running.
  • Uber SMS (Key 1): the grease combo is steady at ~90k/day, but only 4% verified (being stopped). A ja4-dict1 burst of 45k in 1 hour on Oct 18 06h was 92% verified.

New keys hit this weekend

  • WBD Account Lookup (Key 20): 435k on Oct 18 on the live TT (23% verified), with a 188k/h peak at 19h UTC, plus 79k on the grease combo.
  • WBD Login (Key 8): 203k on Oct 18 on the live TT (39% verified) and 103k on grease (77% verified), with ~54k/h at 21-22h UTC.
  • AT&T Consumer SDK Android (Key 4): 30k on di-dict3 on Oct 18 09-10h, 0% verified.
  • WBD Multi-Tenant Login (Key 18): 120k on ja4-dict1 in a 1-hour burst on Oct 16 08h (84% verified), then 11k on the live TT on Oct 17.
  • Tinder PreSMS (Key 3): 19k on ends-te on Oct 17, 0% verified.
  • Olo Payments (Key 3): di-dict3 and the live TT since Oct 17 (10-12k/day, 0-5% verified, still running).
  • Smaller: Roblox Login (14k on single-click, 1% verified), Amazon IDS (11k on single-click) and Meta Login (5.7k on ja4-dict1, 0% verified).

Mitigated or stopped

  • GitLab Sign Up: the ja4-dict1 attack peaked at 361k on Oct 16 (0% verified) and stopped at Oct 17 10:00 UTC. The rta combo on GitLab stopped at the same time.
  • Pinterest Login and Registration stopped matching ja4-dict1 on Oct 16 ~05h, which confirms it was a client change. Keep Pinterest excluded.
  • Roblox Game Join (Key 6) has been quiet since its Oct 15 burst. The Microsoft Signup bursts are fading (2.5k, 0% verified).
  • Adobe Sign-in (Key 5): its normal ~400k/day on the grease combo dropped to ~40k from Oct 17.

New attack discovery

  • No new combination is proposed. Weekend single-flag spikes are the same attacks on the keys above.
  • Watch: g-spoofing-user-agent + g-di-bad-signature-list-match + g-device-parameter-spoofing appeared only on Uber SMS, Oct 17-18 (~30-55k/day, 30-50% verified). It is one key and one day so far, so it is not proposed yet.

Appendix — how these were found

Weekend re-run, 2026-10-19 01:30 UTC. Step 1: 40 single flags or global TTs had >=3 keys spiking. Dropped as already known: the g-ip-datacenter / hosting / shared-egress / connection-type-velocity family and g-ip-asn-reputation-high-risk-with-session-signal (artifacts excluded on Oct 14-15). Most of the rest are the parts of attacks already tracked here, on keys already charted. Examples: g-pagebio-null-...-rfc-ct-before-cl (live TT) on 11 keys, led by Adobe ARP, WBD Account Lookup and WBD Login. di-short-300 / ja4-dict-1 / g-di-dict-1-5x on GitLab, Adobe Commerce and WBD Multi-Tenant. cdn-header-order-does-not-contain-origin / header-ua-ua-mismatch / g-operating-system-spoofing on WBD Account Lookup and GitLab, i.e. the same sessions. g--e-ja4-global-cluster-strict: Pinterest ~1.2M/day from a zero baseline, high verified, same as the Pinterest client change seen on Oct 14-16. Not an attack. One new candidate: g-spoofing-user-agent + g-di-bad-signature-list-match + g-device-parameter-spoofing on Uber SMS only (~30-55k on Oct 18, ~30-50% verified, ~0 before Oct 17). It is a single key and a single day so far, overlapping the Oct 18 06h Uber ja4-dict1 burst, so it is watched, not proposed. No new key beyond those charted reached the burst bar. Steady 0%-verified streams: Blizzard ROW Support (~15k/day on the grease + di-dict3 combos) and Bumble SMS (~10k/day on the live TT) are already blocked.
